notes:
Quick CRM summary: Archipelago Insights builds geospatial analytics for maritime logistics — heavy reranking + embeddings workload across large doc corpus. Technical fit confirmed (SE demo, tokenization/profile done). Primary objection: unit economics don't pencil at scale. Detailed:
- Workload profile: 25k q/day (expected growth to 80k q/day in 9 months), reranking pipeline = embed corpus (3.2M docs), then candidate rerank using 1-2k tokens per query on average.
- Cost sensitivity: Finance requires predictable per-query opcost <= $0.004/query at 80k q/day threshold. Current hosted API estimates translate to ~$0.0065-$0.009/query depending on model chosen.
- GPU/run-rate mismatch: they prefer smaller monthly commit (1-2 rtx-gpu equiv) but Redwood Dedicated minimum commit and 6-month reservation pushed ARR above their CFO comfort level.
- Competitor angle: Archipelago has an alternate offer from vendor X (consumption-first pricing + lower list token price) and is evaluating a hybrid approach (open model via competitor + internal cache to reduce consumption). CTO comment on call: "If we must lock a 6-mo commit we need a clear delta in $/q; otherwise consumption beats us for first 12 months." 
- Security: VPC + KMS + audit logging are mandatory; security team raised residency questions for embeddings stored in managed index. Redwood passed initial security checklist but legal wants a SOC2 + written residency guarantees for EU customers (they operate NA but plan EU later).
- POC: SE ran a small POC on hosted API (internal sandbox) — performance was good, latency meets SLOs. Main gap remains cost model.
- Internal org: No clear executive champion after CTO left for another role in Jan; current sponsor is Head of ML (director level) without procurement authority.
- Next steps suggested: present a consumption-blend pricing (hosted variable + floor commit) or offer a 3-month low-minimum pilot for economics proof. Finance said they'd re-open if Redwood can show a 20-30% reduction in projected $/query or flexible ramping on commit size.
- Current health: stalled/procurement freeze. Re-engage target: post Q2 budget cycle (early July). Risk: high — likely to close with competitor unless pricing is more flexible or a smaller pilot is accepted.
- Stubs/refs: Fireflies ff-arch-20260205-001, pricing deck (drive link), security scan notes (drive link), Jira RED-5421 for billing question.
